about: Step 2 checker-row fixture (docs/ANALYTICS.md): every hero decision of the pinned analytics hands and tests/test/fixtures/stats, with a made-up stored analysis (options, EV loss, facts). rows.json is what analyticsRows / analytics_rows derive from it; sums.json is what analytics_checker (web) and the store's checker reader (desktop) return over it. Read by tests/test/analyticsRows.test.ts, core/rail-stats/tests/analytics_rows.rs, core/rail-store/tests/checker.rs and supabase/tests/database/analytics_checker.test.sql (which embeds a copy).
